title: Identification of common genetic features and pathways for osteoporosis with frozen shoulder by integrated bioinformatics analysis and machine learning.
authors: Yu, Xiaofeng; Ma, Zhenyu; Jin, Lu
journal: The Korean journal of physiology & pharmacology : official journal of the Korean Physiological Society and the Korean Society of Pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学和机器学习分析骨质疏松与冻结肩的共享基因特征，虽涉及转录因子调控网络，但核心是疾病共病机制与诊断标志物，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Frozen shoulder (FS) and osteoporosis (OP) are common age-related degenerative diseases, occurring more frequently in females, which suggests potential molecular links between them. This study aimed to identify shared genetic features and pathways of OP and FS using bioinformatics and machine learning approaches. Gene expression data for OP and FS were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus database. Common differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified. Functional enrichment analysis, protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks construction, and machine learning algorithms were applied to screen key genes. Diagnostic value was evaluated by receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis. Immune infiltration and regulatory networks involving transcription factors and miRNAs were explored. Potential therapeutic compounds were also predicted. A total of 111 common DEGs were identified, enriched in pathways related to neurological development, cellular signaling, and immune regulation. PPI analysis revealed 14 hub genes, with SDC1 and ELN identified as key diagnostic markers by machine learning. ROC curves confirmed their diagnostic efficacy for both OP and FS. Immune infiltration analysis revealed distinct immune cell patterns in OP, correlating with the expression of key gene. Regulatory network analysis demonstrated complex transcriptional regulation of SDC1 and ELN. Drug prediction identified five candidate small molecules targeting these genes. This study uncovered shared genetic features of FS and OP through comprehensive bioinformatics analysis, enhancing understanding of their co-morbidity mechanisms. These findings provide a theoretical basis for identifying novel diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets, facilitating the development of precise diagnostic strategies for OP with FS.
abstract_zh: 肩周炎（Frozen Shoulder, FS）和骨质疏松症（Osteoporosis, OP）是常见的年龄相关性退行性疾病，在女性中更为多发，提示两者之间可能存在分子层面的关联。本研究旨在利用生物信息学和机器学习方法，识别OP与FS的共享遗传特征及通路。从基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus）数据库获取OP和FS的基因表达数据，鉴定共同差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）。应用功能富集分析、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络构建及机器学习算法筛选关键基因，并通过受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic, ROC）曲线评估其诊断价值。同时，探讨了免疫浸润及涉及转录因子和miRNA的调控网络，并预测潜在的治疗化合物。共鉴定出111个共同DEGs，富集于神经发育、细胞信号传导和免疫调节相关通路。PPI分析揭示14个枢纽基因，其中SDC1和ELN被机器学习确定为关键诊断标志物。ROC曲线证实了它们对OP和FS的诊断效能。免疫浸润分析显示OP中免疫细胞模式存在差异，并与关键基因表达相关。调控网络分析展示了SDC1和ELN的复杂转录调控机制。药物预测识别出五种靶向这些基因的候选小分子。本研究通过综合生物信息学分析揭示了FS与OP的共享遗传特征，增进了对其共病机制的理解。这些发现为识别新型诊断生物标志物和治疗靶点提供了理论基础，有助于开发针对伴有FS的OP的精准诊断策略。
